content: Participants mostly rely on the models compared in BIBREF0 and apply modifications to improve them. In particular, most teams make use of skip-gram with negative sampling (SGNS) based on BIBREF13 to learn the semantic spaces of the two time periods and orthogonal procrustes (OP) to align these vector spaces, similar to the approach by BIBREF14. Different meaning representations such as sense clusters are used as well. As measure to detect the degree of LSC all teams except one choose cosine distance (CD). This team uses Jensen-Shannon distance (JSD) instead, which computes the distance between probability distributions BIBREF15.
